column3: Cinematic film still, late night in a dim Korean apartment kitchen, a tired young Korean mother in her early 30s holding her sleeping baby in one arm and a smartphone in the other hand, her face lit only by the cool blue glow of the phone screen, a can of infant formula on the counter beside her, worried expression, warm tungsten practical light far in background, anamorphic 35mm, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, moody, no readable text anywhere.

Cinematic film still, modern Korean food company marketing office in the evening, a Korean female marketing manager in her late 30s in a blazer sits in front of a large monitor showing a long e-commerce product detail page made entirely of colorful product photos and banner images of a carton beverage, she leans back frowning thoughtfully, glass walls, city lights bokeh behind, teal and orange grade, photorealistic, no readable text, no logos.

Cinematic film still, the same two Korean brothers from the reference image working late at night in their small startup studio, older brother with glasses and navy shirt pointing at a monitor full of structured data tables and code, younger brother in lavender hoodie typing on a keyboard beside him, purple and soft white practical lights, dual monitors glowing, focused determined expressions, over-the-shoulder medium shot, 35mm film look, photorealistic, screens show abstract blurred data, no readable text.

Cinematic macro shot, a printed food product nutrition facts label image on a glowing screen, a thin purple scanning laser line sweeps across it, and the small printed numbers and words lift off the surface as luminous floating particles and glowing glyph fragments rising toward the camera, dark background, volumetric light, depth of field, sci-fi but grounded, highly detailed, photorealistic, no legible words.

Cinematic wide shot, an abstract digital space at night where thousands of glowing white and purple data cards stream in from two directions, one stream from a vast government archive of shelves made of light and one stream of scanned product images, they merge into a clean bright floating minimalist website made of white panels and tidy rows of nutrition data, tiny comet-like lights representing AI crawlers fly toward it, volumetric god rays, elegant, high-end tech commercial look, no readable text.

Cinematic film still, morning light in the same kind of Korean apartment kitchen, the young Korean mother in her early 30s smiling with relief at her smartphone while her baby giggles in a high chair beside her, warm golden sunlight through window, a can of infant formula on the table, soft natural colors, 35mm film look, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, no readable text.

Cinematic wide film still at dawn, the same two Korean brothers from the reference image standing on a Seoul rooftop looking out over the city skyline as the sun rises, soft purple and orange sky, older brother with glasses in navy shirt and younger brother in lavender hoodie, seen from behind at three-quarter angle with faces partly visible, hopeful mood, wind in hair, anamorphic lens flare, photorealistic, no text.
